title: DT-JEPA: Learning to Predict Future Representations for Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2610.32657v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision Transformer (DT) has demonstrated strong performance in various offline reinforcement learning (RL) tasks by conditioning action generation on expected future returns and historical trajectories. However, treating expected future returns as the condition provides an incomplete description of the future, as trajectories with different state transitions and behaviors may share similar returns. Moreover, expected future returns inherently depend on task-specific reward functions, which makes policy learning reliant on reward-labeled datasets and restricts its scalability to tasks with similar but unseen rewards. Recently, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) have emerged as a promising paradigm of self-supervised learning-based world models, which learn predictive representations of future dynamics in latent space rather than reconstructing future states in the original space. translated_title: DT-JEPA：学习预测未来表征以进行决策
translated_abstract: 决策Transformer（DT）通过以预期未来回报和历史轨迹为条件来生成动作，在各种离线强化学习（RL）任务中展现出了强大的性能。然而，将预期未来回报作为条件对未来提供了不完整的描述，因为具有不同状态转移和行为的轨迹可能拥有相似的回报。此外，预期未来回报本质上依赖于任务特定的奖励函数，这使得策略学习依赖于带有奖励标注的数据集，并限制了其向具有相似但未见过的奖励的任务扩展的能力。最近，联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）已成为一种有前景的基于自监督学习的世界模型范式，它在潜在空间中学习未来动态的预测表征，而不是在原始空间中重建未来状态。受JEPA启发，我们提出了DT-JEPA
tldr: 提出DT-JEPA，将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与决策Transformer相结合，通过在潜在空间中预测未来动态表征来替代以预期回报作为条件，从而克服回报条件描述未来的不完整性，并摆脱对奖励标注数据集的依赖。
en_tdlr: DT-JEPA integrates Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture with Decision Transformer to predict future latent representations instead of conditioning on expected returns, overcoming the incompleteness of return-based descriptions of the future and the reliance on reward-labeled datasets.
